title: Smart Folders: save from the scope bar or a menu, say what is saved, warn before replacing, and stop leaking Kind, Contents and the filter into later browsing
problem: (1) The only way to save a search is the Save button inside the Nushell filter bar (src/finder/filter.rs:278-290, the sole caller of `save_smart_folder_dialog`, src/finder/dialogs.rs:859). The scope bar shown for every search has no such button (src/finder/bars.rs:61-182) and there is no action or menu item (src/actions.rs:372-388 lists Find, Filter with Nushell and Search Syntax only). A plain search cannot be saved until the user finds Cmd+Alt+F. (2) The dialog's summary names only the words and the filter, e.g. 'Shows log where size > 10kb, kept up to date' (dialogs.rs:877-884, 892-897), although the scope folder, Kind and Name/Contents are saved too (filter.rs:183-199). (3) `add_smart_folder` starts with `retain(|f| f.name != folder.name)` (filter.rs:201-206), silently replacing an existing Smart Folder of that name; the name field is prefilled with the query (dialogs.rs:864-865), so saving the same words twice with a different kind, scope or filter under the default name deletes the first, and the toast still says 'Saved name in the sidebar' (dialogs.rs:938). With an empty name, Save and Return do nothing and give no feedback (dialogs.rs:930-933). (4) Opening one overwrites the tab's Kind, Name/Contents, scope and filter (filter.rs:226-232) and nothing puts them back: `navigate` only ends the search (src/finder/mod.rs:893-898) and the filter is cleared only by its own close button (filter.rs:167-175). After clicking a Smart Folder and then Documents, the Documents listing is still filtered by its `where` clause, and because `kind_filter` is a saved per-tab setting (crates/fffinder-core/src/config.rs:619; `set_kind` calls settings_changed, mod.rs:1470-1476) a Smart Folder's Kind, say Image, stays the Kind for later searches, new tabs and the next launch (written to settings.json, mod.rs:2295-2309). (5) The sidebar marks a Smart Folder active when only the words and filter match (src/finder/sidebar.rs:893-899), so two saved searches with the same words but different Kind or scope light up together. (6) The row's menu has only 'Remove from Sidebar' (sidebar.rs:934-944), and a scope folder that no longer exists silently turns into a This Computer search (filter.rs:219-225).
proposal: 1. Add a `SaveSearch` action in src/actions.rs handled by `save_smart_folder_dialog`; put a small Save button (id `save-search`) in `render_scope_bar` beside the funnel (bars.rs:115-138), list 'Save Search...' in the Edit menu and the Actions (...) menu, and bind Cmd+S in the Finder context (unused, actions.rs:125-246). 2. Build the dialog summary from `view.read(cx).current_smart_folder(String::new())`: the words, 'in <Folder>' or 'This Computer', the Kind when not Any, 'contents' when on, and the filter, e.g. 'Shows names matching log in Projects, kind Images, where size > 10kb. Kept up to date.'; give the line id `smart-summary` and `.test_support()`. On each render read the field's trimmed value: if a Smart Folder with that name exists, show a muted line with id `smart-exists` ('A Smart Folder named x is already in the sidebar; saving replaces it.') and label the primary button 'Replace'; disable the primary button while the name is empty; in `submit_smart_folder` make the toast say 'Replaced x' when it replaced one. 3. In `open_smart_folder` remember once what it displaced (`kind_filter`, `search_contents`, `scope`, filter text; e.g. a `kind_before_smart: Option<KindFilter>` field). When the search ends (`end_search`, and the empty-query branch of `set_query`, mod.rs:1330-1338), put back each value that still equals what the Smart Folder set and clear its filter. 4. `smart_is_active`: compare the saved folder with `current_smart_folder(name)`, all fields. 5. Context menu: add 'Rename...' (reusing the name dialog) and 'Update with Current Search' (enabled while searching); when the scope folder is missing, push a warning notification instead of widening silently. Update docs/manual.md and CHANGELOG.md.
original_test_plan: A headless test that needs no `nu` (the existing one, tests/controls.rs:1416, is skipped without it): type a search, `ui.click("save-search")`, assert `ui.dialog_open()`, type a name, `ui.click("smart-save")`, assert `smart_folders()` holds the query, kind and scope with no filter. Dialog: with the search scoped to the fixture folder and a kind chosen, assert `ui.snapshot("smart-summary").label()` mentions the folder name and the kind; save as 'Big logs', open the dialog again, type 'Big logs', and assert `ui.exists("smart-exists")`, that `smart-save`'s label is 'Replace', and after saving `smart_folders().len()` is still 1; clear the field and assert `smart-save` is disabled and Return leaves the dialog open. Leak test: `set_kind(KindFilter::Image)`, save, `set_kind(KindFilter::Any)`, end the search, click `("smart", 0)`, then `ui.go_to(&fx.dir)` (or Escape and search again) and assert `config().kind_filter == KindFilter::Any`, `filter_text() == ""` and `!searches_contents()`. Active state: save the same words twice with different kinds and assert only the opened one reports active (expose `smart_is_active` through a `#[doc(hidden)]` accessor). Right-click `("smart", 0)`, 'Rename...', type, confirm, assert the new name. Extend the nu test (controls.rs:1452-1470) to check the summary mentions the filter. Add `SaveSearch` to the handler-availability list at tests/controls.rs:227-281.
original_risks: Restoring must not undo a Kind the user changed on purpose while inside the Smart Folder, hence 'only values still equal to what it set'; it also changes what ends up in settings.json after a Smart Folder was opened. `set_query` has no `window`, so the filter field's text has to be reset from `end_search` and the search-field change handler. `smart-save` is clicked by an existing test; keep the id when the label changes. The parts are independent; 1 and 2 are the quick win if the rest is deferred. The always-visible cue for a non-Any Kind (tinted Kind button, 'Any Kind' button in the empty state) is in empty-state-messages.

verifier.claim_check:
All six described behaviours hold on lane-a (b300733). Two details are overstated, and nothing has been implemented yet in any lane.

(1) True. `save_smart_folder_dialog` (src/finder/dialogs.rs:859) has one caller, the filter bar's Save button, drawn only while searching (src/finder/filter.rs:278-290). The scope bar (src/finder/bars.rs:61-182) has only the funnel, (i) and Kind. `actions!` (src/actions.rs:9-98) and the Edit menu (372-388) have no save action, and nothing binds secondary-s (125-246; none in gpui-base or gpui-component either). Overstated: the filter bar also opens from the scope bar's funnel (bars.rs:116-138) and Actions > "Filter with Nushell…" (src/finder/toolbar.rs:807-811), not only Cmd+Alt+F. The placement is documented (docs/manual.md:643), so it is deliberate, but a plain search has no visible Save.

(2) True. The summary is the query plus the filter (dialogs.rs:877-884, 896), while `current_smart_folder` also saves kind, scope and contents (filter.rs:184-199).

(3) True. `add_smart_folder` retains by name then pushes (filter.rs:201-206), so it replaces silently and moves the row to the end. The name is prefilled with the query (dialogs.rs:864-865), the toast always says "Saved" (938), and an empty name returns false with no feedback (930-933).

(4) True. `open_smart_folder` (filter.rs:215-237) assigns the scope (221/224), `config.kind_filter` (226), `search_contents` (227) and the filter field and bar (228-232). It also wipes a filter the user had typed when the saved search has none. `navigate` -> `end_search` (src/finder/mod.rs:893-898, 1350-1356) only clears the query, and `rebuild_rows` applies `self.filter` to folder listings too (mod.rs:1261, filter.rs:96-109), so the next folder is filtered. Overstated: the bar stays visibly open, and it also closes through the funnel or Cmd+Alt+F toggle (filter.rs:152-165), not only its close button. `kind_filter` is an "own" setting (crates/fffinder-core/src/config.rs:617-620). The next `settings_changed`, for example from `location_changed` (mod.rs:918-921), publishes it (mod.rs:2295-2309), and `Finder::new` starts new tabs from that (mod.rs:477). A sticky Kind is by design (CHANGELOG.md:78, manual.md:1075); a sidebar click changing it is documented nowhere.

(5) True. `smart_is_active` compares only the query and filter (src/finder/sidebar.rs:893-899).

(6) True. The menu has only "Remove from Sidebar" (sidebar.rs:934-944, manual.md:207), and a missing scope folder falls through to This Computer silently (filter.rs:219-225).

Tests: only tests/controls.rs:1416-1487 touches Smart Folders. It is skipped without nu and never navigates after opening one, so no test pins the leak. No test asserts the Actions menu's exact items.
verifier.implementation_notes:
Parts A-D are the core. Part E is optional polish and can be split off.

A. Save from the scope bar, a menu and a key
- src/actions.rs: add `SaveSearch` to `actions!`, bind `key("secondary-s", SaveSearch, &finder, cx)`, and add `MenuItem::action("Save Search…", SaveSearch)` to the Edit menu after Find.
- src/finder/mod.rs render: add `.on_action(cx.listener(Self::save_search))` beside `toggle_filter` (line 3112). The handler calls `save_smart_folder_dialog`; when not searching, push a short notification rather than doing nothing.
- src/finder/bars.rs `render_scope_bar`: MOVE the button from filter.rs:278-290 to just before the funnel (line 116), keeping the id `save-smart-folder`, and delete the filter bar's copy. Whenever the old button showed, the scope bar shows too, so nothing is lost. Two elements with one id would make `window.click(id)` ambiguous. Keeping the id leaves the existing nu test (controls.rs:1456) untouched.
- Keep the button a plain wrapping flex child: tests/basics.rs:617-631 checks the bar still wraps at 640 px.
- src/finder/toolbar.rs `actions_menu`: add `PopupMenuItem::new("Save Search…").disabled(!finder.is_searching()).action(Box::new(SaveSearch))` near line 807.

B. Dialog
- Add a pure `SmartFolder::summary()` in crates/fffinder-core/src/config.rs using `entry::display_name` and `KindFilter::label()`.
  - Labels are singular ("Image", not "Images").
  - Leave Kind out when it is Any or when `contents` is on: `content_search` ignores kind (mod.rs:1398-1399).
  - A filter starting with `|` is a pipeline, so do not print "where | …".
- dialogs.rs:877-897: build the line from `view.read(cx).current_smart_folder(String::new())`. It needs `.id("smart-summary").aria_label(text.clone())` as well as `.test_support()`: a snapshot's `label()` is the accessibility label, not rendered text (pattern at bars.rs:392-396).
- The dialog builder runs on every frame (batch_rename.rs:113-147 relies on this), so read `input.read(cx).value().trim()` there. If a Smart Folder with that name exists, show the muted `smart-exists` line and label `smart-save` "Replace". Add `.disabled(name.is_empty())`.
- filter.rs `add_smart_folder`: replace in place (`iter_mut().find(..)`, else push) so the row keeps its position. `submit_smart_folder` says "Replaced …" when it replaced one.

C. Stop the leak
- Add one private field to `Finder` (struct at mod.rs:284, literal at 537), e.g. `smart_before: Option<SmartBefore>`. It holds kind, contents, scope, filter text and `filter_open` as they were, plus what the Smart Folder set.
- `open_smart_folder`: record it AFTER the leading `navigate`/`end_search`, which leaves any earlier Smart Folder, and before assigning.
- For Kind also set `self.published.kind_filter = folder.kind`. This is the idiom `show_folder_view` uses (mod.rs:2074-2078, "Opening a folder isn't choosing anything, so there's nothing to publish"). The saved Kind then never reaches settings.json or new tabs, which closes the settings.json risk the candidate left open.
- New `leave_smart_folder(&mut self, window, cx)`: `take()` the field. For each value still equal to what the Smart Folder set, put the earlier one back.
  - Kind: set both `config` and `published`.
  - Filter: `filter_input.set_value`, `filter_open`, `filter_debounce = Task::ready(())`, then `set_filter`.
  - Restore the displaced filter rather than always clearing it, so a filter the user had typed before comes back.
- Call it from two places, not from `set_query`:
  - at the end of `end_search` (mod.rs:1350), unconditionally, after the query is cleared. This covers navigate, back, forward, up, reveal, Escape in the files and New Folder.
  - in `on_search_event`'s Change arm (mod.rs:1304-1307) when the query became empty. Escape and the clear button in the search field arrive there, because `InputState::clean` emits Change while `set_value` does not (gpui-base input/base/state.rs:1218-1226).
- `set_query` has no window. Resetting `self.filter` without the field's text would leave the bar showing a filter that is not applied.

D. Active row
- sidebar.rs:893: `self.current_smart_folder(folder.name.clone()).as_ref() == Some(folder)` (`SmartFolder` derives `PartialEq`). Expose it with a `#[doc(hidden)]` accessor for tests.

E. Optional: row menu and missing scope
- sidebar.rs:934-944: add "Rename…" as a small dialog modelled on `open_rename_dialog` (dialogs.rs:740-789), reusing the ids `smart-name` and `smart-save`. Refuse a name another Smart Folder already has.
- Pitfall: `sidebar_key` hashes only `smart_folders().len()` (sidebar.rs:224). Hash the names too, or the cached row width goes stale after a rename.
- "Update with Current Search": `.disabled(!is_searching)`, replacing in place.
- filter.rs:222-225: when `folder.scope.is_some()` but it is not a folder, push a Warning notification naming it.

Docs
- docs/manual.md lines 207, 330-338, 643, 781, 847 and the shortcut table near 871; CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased].

All UI tests run headless on Linux and need no nu. Use tests/controls.rs with `common::{Fixture, Ui, Open, cmd}`.

1. Save a plain search

- `ui.type_text("Atlas")`; `ui.click("smart-save")`; assert `ui.read(|f| f.smart_folders().to_vec())` is one entry with query "atlas", kind Any, scope None, contents false, filter None.
- `ui.press(&cmd("s"))` while searching opens the dialog. `ui.dispatch(SaveSearch)` with no search leaves `!ui.dialog_open()`.

2. Dialog
- `ui.click("scope-folder")`; `ui.update(|f,_,cx| f.set_kind(KindFilter::Document, cx))`; open the dialog; assert `ui.snapshot("smart-summary").label()` contains the fixture folder's name and "Document".

3. Leak
- `ui.update(|f,_,cx| f.add_smart_folder(SmartFolder { name, query: "atlas".into(), kind: KindFilter::Folder, scope: Some(fx.path("Projects")), contents: false, filter: Some("size > 1kb".into()) }, cx))`.
- `ui.click(("smart", 0usize))`; assert kind Folder, `search_scope() == SearchScope::Folder`, `filter_text() == "size > 1kb"`. Without nu the filter only sets an error; the text is still stored.
- `ui.go_to(&fx.dir)`; assert `config().kind_filter == KindFilter::Any`, `search_scope() == SearchScope::Computer`, `filter_text() == ""`, `!ui.exists("filter-input")`, `ui.names().len() == 4`.
- Variants: leave with `ui.click("search")` then `ui.press("escape")`; `contents: true` then `!searches_contents()`; pick another Kind from the `kind` menu while inside, and it stays after leaving.

- `ui.press(&cmd("t"))` and assert `tabs(&ui)[1]`'s `config().kind_filter` is Any.

5. Active row
- Add two Smart Folders with the same query and different kinds; click `("smart", 0usize)`; assert the accessor returns (true, false).

6. Part E
- Scope `Some(fx.path("gone"))`: click; assert `ui.notification_count() == 1` and scope is Computer.
- `ui.right_click(("smart", 0usize))`; `ui.click_menu_item("Rename…")`; type; `ui.click("smart-save")`; assert the new name.

7. Existing tests
- Add `SaveSearch.boxed_clone()` to `every_menu_bar_action_has_a_handler` (controls.rs:227-281).
- Extend the nu test (controls.rs:1479-1483): after the smart click, `ui.go_to(&fx.path("Projects"))` and assert `filter_text() == ""` and `ui.names() == ["atlas"]`.

8. Unit test
- `SmartFolder::summary` in the `mod tests` of crates/fffinder-core/src/config.rs (line 854): Name vs Contents, scope vs This Computer, Kind omitted for Any and for contents, a `|` pipeline.
verifier.risks:
- `end_search` sits on every navigation path. The restore must be a no-op unless a Smart Folder was opened (`Option::take`), and must run after the query is cleared so the setters' `run_search` calls return early.
- Behaviour change: a Smart Folder's filter, Kind, Contents and scope no longer survive leaving it. Anyone who used a Smart Folder as a way to load a filter and then browse folders with it loses that. It is undocumented, but say so in the CHANGELOG.
- Comparing by equality cannot tell "untouched" from "changed and changed back"; that case restores the earlier value. Clearing the remembered value inside `set_kind`, `set_scope` and `set_search_contents` is more exact if that matters.
- Moving Save out of the filter bar changes documented UI (manual.md:643). If both buttons are kept instead, they need different ids.
- Cmd+S is a new commitment in the key table. With `--term` it also becomes Ctrl+S through `ctrl_alias`; raw mode delivers it, but some terminals or multiplexers may intercept it.
- A rename without hashing names in `sidebar_key` leaves a stale row width in tree mode.
- The change spans about ten source files. bars.rs (scope bar) and mod.rs (`end_search`, `on_search_event`) are likely conflict points with other search-UI candidates, such as the Kind-button cue in empty-state-messages.
- Nothing here was compiled or run; the review is from reading the code only.

orchestrator_notes: 'regex-content-search' may land before this one and add a contents-search mode. If it is on the trunk, a Smart Folder has to save and restore that mode with the rest.
